What the upland farming records tell us

Published 18 April 2020.

Tithe apportionments

The tithe surveys of 1836 to 1852 name every field and its occupier. For upland townships they are often the first complete picture of who worked what.

Enclosure awards

Enclosure awards, mostly 1770 to 1830 in the Dales, record the allotment of common grazing. They explain the straight-walled fields on the fell edge.

Stint registers

Stint registers record grazing rights in units of sheep. A stint of 40 on Malham Moor was a substantial holding.
